title: How Egyptians Made Papyrus | V1 Illustrated Short
script:
How did a Nile plant become ancient Egypt's writing material?

Workers harvested papyrus reeds and stripped away their outer layers.

They laid the soft pith strips across each other in two directions.

Heavy presses flattened the layers into sheets that could dry.

Finally, scribes wrote their records on the finished papyrus.
